name: gen_rifle_idle
prompt: A person stands in a rifle shooting stance, left foot forward, holding a rifle shouldered with both hands — right hand at the grip near the chest, left arm extended forward supporting the barrel — aiming down the sights with the head lowered to the cheek. They hold the aim steadily with only a subtle breathing sway, feet planted.
note: Companion to gen_pistol_idle: shouldered-rifle aim loop. Take 4 of 8 — cleanest loop numbers of the batch (foot skate 0.001, loop gap 0.012, loop velocity gap 0.02) and a mid-height stance. First 0.5s trimmed as settle; detrend so the breathing sway survives without drift; 0.4s tail blend closes the loop. Extras if the stance reads wrong: take 2 sits lower with the forward arm flatter, take 3 flares the rear elbow higher, take 7 stands most upright.
